text:
louise: FYI Meridian Analytics (MER-404) put account on hold. INV-2026-721 (due 2026-05-12) unpaid: $54,910. They claim VAT was double-billed and want the VAT portion (~$4,420) escrowed pending their audit. They offered to pay 50% now by card and put disputed VAT into escrow with a 3rd-party trustee.
nate: Any prior disputes or chargebacks?
billing-bot: Last successful payment 2026-03-11. Charge attempt 2026-05-13 failed: card declined. Past due: $54,910. Reattempt scheduled 2026-05-18.
rachel: Sales says MER is 2yr customer, at-risk for renewal if we start a collections thread. Procurement is pushing hard on VAT reconciliation.
sam: Finance: escrow is unusual for SaaS. We can accept partial payment + conditional credit pending audit. If they insist on escrow, we need legal + finance to sign trustee agreement and confirm fees. Also require PO matching invoice.
legal-bot: Legal: we can do escrow but need a short escrow agreement (scope, release conditions, dispute timeline). Also require written signed acceptance from customer. Escrow admin fees billed to customer.
procurement-bot: Procurement: buyer says their AP has a standing rule: disputed VAT lines go into escrow. They provided a template trustee (AcornTrust) and expected us to accept.
louise: Sales preference: accept 50% now to avoid churn, provisionally withhold add-on provisioning, and allow escrow for disputed VAT only if they sign escrow agreement and pay trustee fees.
nate: OK to propose: 50% payment now ($27,455), 25% in 30 days, 25% in 60 days. Disputed VAT ($4,420) either (A) held in escrow by AcornTrust pending 14-day audit or (B) refunded if our telemetry confirms mis-billing. Customer picks option A or B.
rachel: Can we fast-track telemetry check for VAT-relevant line items? Its usually invoicing metadata; ops can verify SKU/tax flags.
sam: Ops can validate invoice SKU/tax tags within 2 business days. If issue is our billing meta, accept credit. If not, escrow.
louise: Draft message to customer (will paste before sending): "Hi Meridian  we received your VAT dispute for INV-2026-721. To prevent service disruption while we investigate, please remit 50% of the invoice ($27,455) via card or wire and confirm which path you prefer for the disputed VAT ($4,420): (A) place disputed VAT into AcornTrust escrow (customer pays trustee fees) for up to 14 business days while both parties reconcile; or (B) allow Redwood to perform an expedited billing audit and issue a credit if we confirm mis-billing. Add-on provisioning will be paused until first payment clears. Please confirm within 5 business days or we will proceed with collections."
nate: I like that. Legal: add one sentence "Acceptance of payment does not waive Redwood's rights to collect any undisputed balance." Also require signed escrow agreement for option A.
legal-bot: Added clause approved. Also require escrow release triggers and dispute arbitration timeline be included.
rachel: Sales ok. Offer to waive one late fee as goodwill if they remit the 50% within 48 hours.
louise: Sending to ap@meridian-analytics.com at 2026-05-14 09:18 UTC  Subject: Action required: INV-2026-721 VAT dispute & payment plan
billing-bot: Note: reattempt scheduled 2026-05-18.
sam: I'll queue ops to validate invoice tax flags and ping once done.
rachel: Keep me posted. If they push for full escrow and delay payment, escalate to CFO. :eyes:
louise: Pasted sent copy above. Will update thread with customer response.
